jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Recommender Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Orbitly runs a travel marketplace used by 3 million people each month.

What you'll do

  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship improvements every week.
  • Own your work from design document to production.

Requirements

  • Production recommender systems.
  • Python and PyTorch.
  • Spark.

Nice to have

  • Kafka for streaming features.

Compensation

€90,000 - €110,000 per year
